Row.Text: All new and existing Workers, Work Boats, Missionaries, Inquisitors, and Settler Units produced by the owner of this Natural Wonder gain the [COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]{TXT_KEY_PROMOTION_SACRED_STEPS}[ENDCOLOR] Promotion, granting them +2 [ICON_MOVES] Movement.
由这个自然奇观的所有者生产的所有新的和现有的工人、工作船、传教士、审判官和定居者单位都获得[COLOR_POSITIVE_TEXT]{TXT_KEY_PROMOTION_SACRED_STEPS}[ENDCOLOR]晋升，给予他们+2[ICON_MOVES]移动。
